summary: A circular identity mark for a person, with optional active ring.
purpose: Show who owns a case or who is speaking. Use instead of a raw image so size and the active ring stay on-token.

anatomy.description: Optional active border when the person is in session.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar size mapped to spacing tokens.

variants.name: active
variants.whenToUse: The person currently in the session.

whenToUse: Identifying a person next to a case, plan, or chat turn.

do: Prefer initials when no photo is available.
Use the size prop, not a hardcoded width.
dont: Hardcode a border color for the active ring.

aria: Provide alt text on the image, or aria-label on the avatar when it conveys meaning.
accessibility.contrast: Initials against the fill hold at least 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus: N/A unless made interactive by the parent.

related.whenToChoose: Badge for counts or status dots; Avatar for identity.
